spans.s: लब्ध (I) a. (f. ब्धा) 1. Taken, received, acquired, obtained; 2. perceived, apprehended, (pp. of लभ् q.v.).
लब्ध (II) n. Anything obtained, लब्धपालनविधौ न तत्सुतः खेदमाप R.xix.3.

लब्ध-अवकाश, -अवसर a. 1. one who has found an opportunity; 2. being at leisure; 3. (anything) that has gained scope, लब्धावकाशो मे मनोरथः Sak.i.

लब्ध-काम a. one who has obtained his wishes.
लब्ध-कीर्ति a. famous, widely known.

लब्ध-लक्ष्य a. 1. one who has hit the mark; 2. skilled in the use of missiles.
लब्ध-वर्ण a. 1. learned, wise; 2. famous, celebrated.

लब्ध-सिद्धि a. 1. one who has obtained his desire; 2. one who has attained perfection.
